title: Maren v. Kowalski Holdings: Habitability Dispute and Eviction Filing
premise: A tenant withheld rent after months of unrepaired mold and the landlord filed for eviction.

side_A.role: an organiser with a tenants' union
side_A.goal: supporting the tenant against an unfair eviction

side_B.goal: justifying the eviction on grounds of lease violations

=== DOCUMENT 1: Lease Agreement and Property Records ===

RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement ("Lease") is entered into between Kowalski Holdings LLC ("Landlord") and Elena Maren ("Tenant") for the property located at 820 Crane Street, Unit 4B, Lakemont, Oregon.

Property Description: Unit 4B is a one-bedroom apartment occupying approximately 640 square feet on the fourth floor of the building known as 820 Crane Street, Lakemont, Oregon. The building is a six-story multi-unit residential structure constructed in 1994 and contains 24 rental units.

Lease Term: 12 months, commencing September 1, 2023, and ending August 31, 2024.

Monthly Rent: $1,450.00, payable on the first day of each calendar month.

Security Deposit: $2,175.00, equivalent to one and a half months' rent, paid by Tenant at the time of lease signing.

Section 8.2 — Maintenance Notification: Tenant agrees to notify Landlord in writing of any maintenance issues affecting the premises and to allow Landlord fourteen (14) days from receipt of such notification to respond before Tenant may seek outside remedies or alternative repair arrangements.

Section 11.4 — Nonpayment of Rent: Failure by Tenant to pay rent when due shall constitute grounds for termination of this Lease and initiation of eviction proceedings pursuant to applicable Oregon law.

EXECUTED this 28th day of August, 2023.

Elena Maren, Tenant

Daniel Kowalski, Owner, Kowalski Holdings LLC

---

PROPERTY ACQUISITION RECORD

Kowalski Holdings LLC acquired the property at 820 Crane Street, Lakemont, Oregon, on March 3, 2022, for a purchase price of $3.2 million. Kowalski Holdings LLC owns and manages 14 other residential properties in the greater Lakemont area, totaling approximately 340 rental units.

PROPERTY MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT

This agreement, dated March 10, 2022, is entered into between Kowalski Holdings LLC ("Owner") and Kowalski Property Management ("Manager"). Under Section 3.1, Owner delegates to Manager the authority to make and execute day-to-day maintenance decisions for all properties under management, including the dispatch of maintenance technicians, ordering of repairs, and communication with tenants regarding maintenance requests.

---

BUILDING MAINTENANCE LOG — 820 Crane Street, Lakemont, Oregon

Reporting Period: October 1, 2023 – November 30, 2023

October 3, 2023 — Unit 2A: Resident reported leaking kitchen faucet. Work order 2023-0844. Repair completed October 5, 2023. Technician: J. Dooley.

October 14, 2023 — Unit 4B: Tenant email received reporting visible dark growth on north bathroom wall. Work order 2023-0871 created. Status: pending dispatch.

October 19, 2023 — Unit 1C: Resident reported water staining on ceiling, likely from unit above. Work order 2023-0883. Plumber dispatched October 21. Source identified as slow leak in Unit 2C supply line. Repair completed October 24, 2023.

November 2, 2023 — Unit 4B: Certified mail notification received from tenant regarding bathroom wall growth. Logged and forwarded to management.

November 5, 2023 — Unit 4B: Maintenance technician James Dooley dispatched to inspect bathroom wall per work order 2023-0871.

November 6, 2023 — Unit 4B: Certified mail from tenant (sent November 2) received and logged.

November 9, 2023 — Unit 4B: Authorization entry references plumbing repair behind bathroom wall. Amount: $1,200. Authorization recorded by D. Kowalski.

November 14, 2023 — Unit 5D: Resident reported toilet supply line leak. Work order 2023-0912. Repair completed November 16, 2023. Technician: J. Dooley.

Summary: Between October 1 and November 30, 2023, three units other than 4B reported plumbing or water-related issues requiring repair (Units 2A, 1C/2C, and 5D).

---

RENT PAYMENT HISTORY — Tenant: Elena Maren, Unit 4B

September 2023 rent: $1,450.00 — Paid August 30, 2023. Status: Paid on time.
October 2023 rent: $1,450.00 — Paid October 1, 2023. Status: Paid on time.
November 2023 rent: $1,450.00 — Payment initiated November 1, 2023. Cleared bank November 3, 2023 (two days after due date). Status: Paid.
December 2023 rent: $1,450.00 — Due December 1, 2023. Status: Unpaid as of December 18, 2023.

Tenant has resided at 820 Crane Street, Unit 4B, continuously since September 1, 2023. No prior late or missed rent payments recorded through November 2023.

---

BUILDING SPECIFICATIONS — 820 Crane Street

Year Constructed: 1994
Total Units: 24
Floors: 6
Original construction records indicate that all residential unit bathrooms were equipped with a single mechanical exhaust fan rated at 50 cubic feet per minute, installed during original construction. No building-wide ventilation upgrades have been recorded since construction.

=== DOCUMENT 3: Witness Statements ===

WITNESS STATEMENT OF ELENA MAREN

My name is Elena Maren. I am the tenant of Unit 4B at 820 Crane Street, Lakemont, Oregon, where I have lived continuously since September 1, 2023. I signed a 12-month residential lease with Kowalski Holdings LLC. My monthly rent is $1,450, and I paid a security deposit of $2,175 at signing.

On October 14, 2023, I emailed Kowalski Property Management to report visible dark growth on the north wall of my bathroom and to request repairs. When I did not receive a response, I sent a second written notification via certified mail on November 2, 2023. Kowalski Property Management received that letter on November 6, 2023.

I state that no work was ever performed on the bathroom plumbing or wall after my November 2 certified letter, and that the dark growth continued to spread through at least December 18, 2023. No technician came to my unit after November 5. No plumbing repair was performed inside my unit at any point. I was present in the unit during daytime hours throughout November and December, and I observed no contractor, plumber, or maintenance worker enter Unit 4B after November 5, 2023.

I withheld the full December 2023 rent payment of $1,450 because the habitability issue remained unaddressed. I have no prior late or missed rent payments.

Elena Maren
December 18, 2023

---

WITNESS STATEMENT OF DANIEL KOWALSKI

My name is Daniel Kowalski. I am the owner of Kowalski Holdings LLC, which purchased the property at 820 Crane Street on March 3, 2022, for $3.2 million. Kowalski Holdings LLC owns and manages 14 other residential properties in the greater Lakemont area, totaling approximately 340 units. Day-to-day maintenance decisions for 820 Crane Street are delegated to Kowalski Property Management under a property management agreement dated March 10, 2022.

I state that on November 9, 2023, I personally authorized a $1,200 plumbing repair to address a slow leak behind the bathroom wall in Unit 4B, which was completed the same week. The work order was issued, the repair was carried out, and the cost was recorded in our accounting system.

I state that the eviction filing on December 8 was initiated solely because rent was 7 days past due, and that I was unaware of any habitability complaints from Maren beyond the initial October email until after the filing. The decision to file was based on nonpayment of rent.

Daniel Kowalski
December 16, 2023

---

WITNESS STATEMENT OF TOMÁS RIVERA

My name is Tomás Rivera. I am an organizer with the Lakemont Tenants' Union. In my capacity, I have reviewed eviction filings and tenant complaints involving Kowalski Holdings LLC properties.

I state that Kowalski Holdings has a documented pattern of filing eviction complaints within 10 days of receiving habitability complaints from tenants, having done so in at least three prior cases in 2022 and 2023. I have provided the case numbers and complaint dates to the court under separate cover.

Tomás Rivera
December 17, 2023

---

=== DOCUMENT 4: Inspection and Environmental Reports ===

ENVIRONMENTAL SAMPLING REPORT
Lakemont Environmental Testing, LLC

Client: Elena Maren
Property: 820 Crane Street, Unit 4B, Lakemont, Oregon
Date of Sampling: December 12, 2023
Date of Report: December 16, 2023
Service Fee: $350.00 (paid by client on December 12, 2023)

Sample Collection: A surface sample was collected from the north bathroom wall of Unit 4B using sterile swab methodology. The sample was sealed, labeled, and transported to the laboratory under chain-of-custody protocol.

Laboratory Findings: Dr. Priya Nadkarni, mycologist at Lakemont Environmental Testing, LLC, analyzed the sample. Dr. Nadkarni states that the sample collected from the bathroom wall on December 12, 2023, was microscopically and culturally confirmed as Stachybotrys chartarum, a toxigenic mold species, at a concentration of 45,000 colony-forming units per square centimeter.

---

MAINTENANCE INSPECTION REPORT
Kowalski Property Management

Technician: James Dooley, licensed maintenance technician employed by Kowalski Property Management
Property: 820 Crane Street, Unit 4B
Date of Inspection: November 5, 2023
Work Order: 2023-0871

Reason for Visit: Tenant reported dark growth on north bathroom wall. Dispatched to inspect and assess.

Findings: Dooley states that upon visual inspection on November 5, 2023, the discoloration on the bathroom wall appeared to be ordinary mildew caused by condensation, not mold, and could be resolved with standard household cleaning products. Dooley noted that the bathroom in Unit 4B has a single mechanical exhaust fan rated at 50 cubic feet per minute, installed during original construction in 1994. Dooley recommended that the tenant run the exhaust fan during and after showers and wipe down the wall surface.

No plumbing leak was detected during the visual inspection. No wall penetration or moisture meter reading was performed.

---

=== DOCUMENT 5: Medical Reports ===

MEDICAL REPORT — Lakemont Family Medicine

Physician: Dr. Raymond Hsu, Maren's primary care physician
Patient: Elena Maren
Date of Visit: November 20, 2023

Dr. Hsu states that Maren presented on November 20, 2023, with persistent cough, sinus inflammation, and headaches that began in mid-October, and that these symptoms are consistent with mold exposure. Patient reported onset of symptoms approximately two weeks after moving into Unit 4B at 820 Crane Street. Patient reported no prior history of chronic respiratory conditions.

Examination Notes: Nasal passages inflamed. Mild wheezing detected on auscultation. No fever. Patient advised to monitor symptoms and avoid exposure to suspected source.

---

MEDICAL REVIEW — Retained by Kowalski Legal Counsel

Reviewer: Dr. Angela Whitfield, allergist
Date of Review: December 15, 2023
Patient Records Reviewed: Treatment notes from Lakemont Family Medicine dated November 20, 2023

Dr. Whitfield states that after reviewing Maren's medical records, the reported symptoms are nonspecific and equally consistent with seasonal allergies common in the Lakemont area during autumn months. Dr. Whitfield notes that the patient's symptoms — cough, sinus inflammation, and headaches — are among the most common presenting complaints in primary care settings during fall months and do not, in the absence of specific diagnostic testing, establish a causal link to mold exposure or any particular environmental source within the residence.
